--- PART 3/4 ---
ORIGIN: NONE
CONTRADICTION: NONE
RESOLUTION: kept using the report — "Parent only got 2.829. We will get much higher." and "Parent's score against one_D_TFT is 1.6792, meaning average 1.68 per round. Our strategy would average much higher."
STRATEGY: Parent cooperates by default, tolerates initial/occasional defections, probes to detect reactive opponents, exploits non-reactive ones, and punishes long defection runs. The trace simulates the parent's reported probe measurements (one_D_TFT, four_D_TFT, four_D_ALLC, sustained_D, periodic_D) and revises the parent by adding a refined reactive check (requiring opponent C then D after own D), deterministic probes at rounds 5 and 15, and continuous reactive detection to escape exploit mode.

--- PART 4/4 ---
ORIGIN: NONE
CONTRADICTION: NONE
RESOLUTION: kept using the report — "I think this strategy is strong and should improve upon the parent."
STRATEGY: Parent probes at rounds 5 and 15, checks for opponent defection runs, overall defection, and immediate retaliation, then exploits if it has defected at least twice. The trace simulates the revised strategy against always-C and reactive opponents, tracing probe/exploit round sequences. It changed the probe schedule and exploit trigger, and removed the parent's use of rng.
